description: This file defines structures, constants, and functions for parsing and handling HTTP Cache-Control directives, including request and response directives, with support for standard and experimental cache directives.

classes.name: RequestCacheDirectives
classes.description: Represents HTTP request cache directives such as max-age, no-cache, no-store, etc.

classes.name: ResponseCacheDirectives
classes.description: Represents HTTP response cache directives including max-age, private, public, and experimental directives.

classes.name: FieldNames
classes.description: Type alias for a map of header field names to booleans, used in cache directives.

classes.name: cacheDirective
classes.description: Internal interface for shared methods of request and response cache directives.

classes.name: DeltaSeconds
classes.description: Type representing delta seconds in cache directives, with parsing support.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a cache directive string into a cacheDirective object, handling tokens and key-value pairs.

methods.name: parseDeltaSeconds
methods.description: Parses a string into a DeltaSeconds value, handling range and overflow.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Adds a token to request or response cache directives, setting boolean flags or errors.

methods.name: addPair
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to request or response cache directives, parsing delta seconds where applicable.

methods.name: ParseRequestCacheControl
methods.description: Parses a Cache-Control header string into RequestCacheDirectives.

methods.name: ParseResponseCacheControl
methods.description: Parses a Cache-Control header string into ResponseCacheDirectives.

methods.name: hasFieldNames
methods.description: Determines if a token is a field name in cache directives.
